name: Gyndore
oneLiner: gynUSD is Gyndore's cbBTC-backed CDP stablecoin on Base, minted at up to 90.91% LTV with on-chain redemptions and Stability Pool liquidations holding the peg.
collateral: cbBTC (Coinbase Wrapped Bitcoin); single-collateral CDPs on Base with 110% minimum collateralization ratio, ~90.91% max LTV
pegMechanism: CDP-based: gynUSD minted against cbBTC at 110% min collateralization ratio. If gynUSD trades below $1, on-chain redemptions allow users to swap gynUSD for $1 of cbBTC. Stability Pool absorbs liquidations; liquidators receive a $100 cbBTC bond per position. Borrow rate (1 to 20%) adjustable in ±10bps steps by GYND holders via the Pareto Controller (80% consensus, 24h challenge window), or by a bootstrapping admin key pre-fee-switch.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: 70% of protocol borrow fees distributed to gynUSD Stability Pool depositors

launchPhaseDetail: Protocol announced with whitepaper published; website live with core metrics showing 'Soon'. Claims audit-first approach but no specific auditor or report confirmed. A public waitlist opened May 21 2026 (waitlist.gyndore.com), reviving social activity after the GitHub repo (last commit Mar 7) and Medium (last post Feb 2) went quiet. A public testnet on Base Sepolia (chain 84532) is open to any EVM wallet using free test assets, running alongside the DropWave points campaign; the testnet was live by August 25 2026, though neither gyndore.com nor Medium records an opening date. The app schedules a Gyndore Liquidity Bootstrapping Event for September 15 2026 to raise launch capital. That event is a capital raise rather than a mainnet date: gyndore.com still lists contract addresses as 'Coming Soon', the footer Audits link resolves to nothing, and no mainnet date has been published, so Pharos records no expected launch date. Two launch configurations planned: bootstrapping (team admin key for borrow rate, transitioning via one-time fee switch to GYND governance) or GYND-from-day-one.

milestones.description: The Gyndore app schedules the Liquidity Bootstrapping Event, a community initiative to raise launch capital, for September 15 2026. It is the project's first dated commitment; mainnet contracts remain unpublished.
